# Seasons of Surrender

> Seasons of Surrender is a memoir by Mark & Paula Batory, published by Quellsicht. A personal memoir of nearly fifty years learning to trust God through missionary service, family, illness, changed plans, and the joy of surrender.

- Authors: Mark & Paula Batory (married 1977; began missionary service the following year; served in Mexico, church planting, ministry among Spanish-speaking people, and missions leadership)
- Publisher: Quellsicht (https://www.quellsicht.com/)
- Format: Paperback
- Structure: four seasons: Trust, Trial, Refinement, Release
- Not to be confused with: "Seasons of Surrender" by Vic Clesceri (a different book) or "Season of Surrender" by August Burns Red (an album)

- [Home](https://www.seasonsofsurrender.org/): book overview, the four seasons, an excerpt ("Three eggs", Chapter 2), the authors, and launch signup
